title: complydoc report, schema 23
description: What a complydoc run writes: an audit, a cost or readiness run, a loader comparison, a chunks run or a pipeline's trace. `run.schema_version` says which version of this shape a file holds.

Box.description: A rectangle in normalised page space, 0.0 to 1.0 on both axes.
Box.title: Box

CategoryChangeRecord.description: One identifier category a run looked for otherwise than as it ships.
CategoryChangeRecord.title: CategoryChangeRecord

CategorySummary.description:
The categories file a run read, and each change it made.

A category with `enabled` false is reported nowhere; the run still looked for it, so
that its values are masked in the report's text.
CategorySummary.title: CategorySummary

ConceptFinding.description:
A page a judgement model says holds one of your concepts.

A whole page rather than a place on it: the model says whether, not where.
Reported at the `model` tier, the weakest of the four.
ConceptFinding.title: ConceptFinding

ConceptRule.description: One custom concept a run looked for, and how often it was found.
ConceptRule.title: ConceptRule

ConceptSummary.description: The concepts file a run read, and each of its concepts.
ConceptSummary.title: ConceptSummary

ContentFinding.description: A passage that is hidden from a reader, reads as an instruction to a model, or both.
ContentFinding.title: ContentFinding

DocumentTiming.description: Wall clock spent on one document.
DocumentTiming.title: DocumentTiming

DocumentVerification.description: Every page of one document a vision model read again, and what it found.
DocumentVerification.title: DocumentVerification

ExtractorReading.description: What one extractor made of one document, totalled over its pages.
ExtractorReading.title: ExtractorReading

FactCheck.description: Whether one expected fact appears in the text of each loader.
FactCheck.title: FactCheck

Factor.description: One input to the global score, and why it came out where it did.
Factor.title: Factor

FormatComparison.description: The loaders compared on the documents of one file type.
FormatComparison.title: FormatComparison

FormatLoaderRow.description: One loader's results on the documents of one file type.
FormatLoaderRow.title: FormatLoaderRow

IdentifierDifference.description:
An identifier in some loaders' output and not in others'.

Matched by where it was found, its category and its masked value, so the
same identifier read by two loaders is one row. Metadata findings are
matched regardless of key name, because loaders spell the same field
differently: `producer` in one, `Producer` in another.
IdentifierDifference.title: IdentifierDifference

IgnoreRule.description: One entry of the ignore file, and what it did on this run.
IgnoreRule.title: IgnoreRule

IgnoreSummary.description: The ignore file a run read, and each of its entries.
IgnoreSummary.title: IgnoreSummary

IgnoredFinding.description:
A finding an ignore file set aside, with the reason it gave.

Kept in the report, so what was ignored stays visible, and out of every
count, limitation, quick win and rule, so it no longer fails a check.
IgnoredFinding.title: IgnoredFinding

Limitation.description: One thing this particular run did not or could not check.
Limitation.title: Limitation

LoaderComparison.description: Where several loaders' output differed, measured against the first.
LoaderComparison.title: LoaderComparison

LoaderRun.description: What an external loader did when complydoc ran it.
LoaderRun.title: LoaderRun

LoaderSummary.description: One loader's totals, in a comparison of several.
LoaderSummary.title: LoaderSummary

MetadataFinding.description:
An identifier found in a document's metadata.

Loaders attach metadata to every document they return, and it is usually
stored beside the content — in a vector store, next to each chunk — so an
identifier there travels exactly as far as one in the text.
MetadataFinding.title: MetadataFinding

batch_vision_input_usd_by_resolution.title: Batch Vision Input Usd By Resolution

OverallReadiness.description: The folder, and every document in it, scored on all three factors.
OverallReadiness.title: OverallReadiness

PageText.description: The text read off one page, for checking extraction quality.
PageText.title: PageText

PageVerification.description: One page read again by a vision model, and whether the two readings agree.
PageVerification.title: PageVerification

QuickWin.description: One recommended action and the documents it applies to.
QuickWin.title: QuickWin

ReadingCost.description:
What one reading of one page cost to make.

A reader that runs on this machine — a text-layer library, local OCR — costs
machine time and no money, and says so as `local` rather than borrowing a
price to look comparable. A hosted reader is `actual` when the provider's
own token count came back with the reading, `estimated` when the figure is
worked out from the page's size and the price table, and `unpriced` when
no price for it is known.
ReadingCost.title: ReadingCost

RoutingSummary.description: How many pages take each route, and what that mix costs.
RoutingSummary.title: RoutingSummary

SensitiveMatch.description: One reported hit. `revealed` is None unless --reveal was passed.
SensitiveMatch.title: SensitiveMatch

SignalResult.description: One row of the readiness table.
SignalResult.title: SignalResult

SkipRecord.description: A file complydoc could not open, or could not finish. Reported; the run continues.
SkipRecord.title: SkipRecord

StageDocument.description:
Schema 18: what a stage passed on, or for an embedding or store stage was given, of
one document, so a document can be followed from its loader to where it was sent.
StageDocument.title: StageDocument

StageIdentifier.description: An identifier in what a stage passed on, or, for an embedding stage, sent.
StageIdentifier.title: StageIdentifier

StagePreview.description: One item a stage passed on, or for an embedding stage sent, as the viewer shows it.
StagePreview.title: StagePreview

StageWarning.description:
Schema 18: something wrong with what a stage passed on that raised no error: a
document that loaded no text, garbled text, near-empty chunks, a text too long for
the embedding model.
StageWarning.title: StageWarning

Thresholds.description:
The lines complydoc draws, written into the report so a reader of it draws the same ones.

Schema 17. The viewer bands scores and marks disagreeing readings on these,
keeping no copy of its own that could drift from them.
Thresholds.title: Thresholds

Trace.description:
Schema 17, with schema 18's documents, warnings and tracebacks on each stage: an
ingestion pipeline observed with `cd.observe`, stage by stage.
Trace.title: Trace

TraceStage.description:
One step of an observed ingestion pipeline: a loader, a splitter, a transformer, an
embedding call, or a function of the caller's own marked with `@cd.stage`.
TraceStage.title: TraceStage

VerificationSummary.description: The folder against an independent vision read: pages checked, and pages that disagree.
VerificationSummary.title: VerificationSummary
